title: desktop tree of Chrome or an Electron app shows only the toolbar, not the page
symptom: desktop find inside Chrome finds only the address bar; typed keys land in the address bar instead of a page field
cause: Chrome and Electron build the page accessibility tree only when an assistive client asks. desktop now turns it on (AXEnhancedUserInterface / AXManualAccessibility) when the web area is empty
fix: launch_cli.py desktop find --window "<title>" --role textfield --max-nodes 1500 --depth 60  # pages are deep
Prefer web find / web type when the page belongs to a pro-launch web session
Type into page fields with desktop type --ref <n> --text <value> --keys (focus is set without the mouse)
